The potentiometer circuit is built (the photoresistor alternative is not). Following the image, the pot's two outer legs sit in the lower half of the breadboard (columns 10 and 12, bank 't') and its middle leg in the upper half (column 11, bank 'b'). Outer leg at column 10 goes to GND, the other to 5V, and the middle (wiper) goes to A0.
Breadboard bank naming follows the catalogue: rows a-e are bank 't' and rows f-j are bank 'b', matching the row letters printed in the image.

The optional external LED circuit is included: pin 13 -> wire4 -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> wire5 -> the GND next to pin 13. Its breadboard columns (20-24) are assumed, as the manual gives no layout.
The GND beside pin 13 is assumed to be catalogue port GND.3. The potentiometer ground wire uses GND.1 on the power header.
The 5V, GND and A0 wires land in the same breadboard column strips as the potentiometer legs, as shown in the image.
